source_scope.local_policy: approved image files only; rejected, qa, reference, raw and source evidence are not counted as ready

methodology.appearance_grouping: Color/finish is visual. Dimensions, size, movement, calibre, Ships From and no-logo qualifiers are technical and mutualized.
methodology.shopify_media_classification: Maison when filename is prefixed by the exact product handle or alt explicitly says Maison Noirmont. Every other file is conservatively supplier_or_aliexpress.
methodology.description_ready: French structured description present and not raw supplier SPECIFICATIONS.
methodology.generation_rule: No generation when a Maison visual is already assigned in Shopify or an approved matching local variant file exists.
methodology.association_rule: A color/finish can reuse one Maison media across size/calibre variants, but every variant without a Maison assignment remains listed for association.
